margin_identity: gross margin = 1 - class_factor; independent of FX and of base price
caveats: The chain applies the distributor and dealer percentages to OUR reduced price. In practice a distributor defending its own absolute margin may not pass the full reduction through, which makes the dealer price fall less than shown. No evidence on pass-through exists on disk; this is arithmetic.
The 43 part numbers are all tagged brand tier 1 with one or two competitors, and up to 18 markets share one part number. Treat as a signal.
FX sensitivity assumes the yen base price is held. In practice IML revises it.
